channel.title: supragnosis news
channel.description: Release notes for supragnosis, and longer notes on what was measured and learned while making it.

item.title: What the agents remember, four days in
item.description: Agents wrote to supragnosis far more often than they read from it. In 0.11.0 a session starts with its project's newest records. Four days of measurement on one machine suggest that reading rose; they do not yet show that the work improved.
